text:
Predicates:
NLP(x) ::: x is a natural language processing task.
Generation(x) ::: x is a language generation task.
Understanding(x) ::: x is a language understanding task.
OutputText(x) ::: the output of x is a text sequence.
Premises:
∀x (NLP(x) → (Generation(x) ⊕ Understanding(x))) ::: Natural language processing tasks can be categorized as either language generation task or language understanding task.
∀x (OutputText(x) → Generation(x)) ::: If the output of a natural language processing task is a text sequence, then it is a language generation task.
NLP(machineTranslation) ::: Machine translation is a natural language processing task.
OutputText(machineTranslation) ::: The output of machine translation is a text sequence.
Conclusion:
Generation(machineTranslation) ::: Machine translation is a language generation task.
